## Question 1

Using the `economics` dataset, make **two** plots of the unemployment rate over time (`x = date`, `y = unemploy / pop`): one with `geom_line()` and one with `geom_point()`. Then make a bar chart of the number of cars in each `class` of the `mpg` dataset using `geom_bar()`.

Write one sentence explaining why a line is the right geom for the unemployment series but a bar is the right geom for the class counts.

## Question 2

Using the `economics` dataset, plot `unemploy / pop` against `uempmed` (median duration of unemployment) with `geom_path()`. Compare it with the same plot drawn with `geom_line()`.

Write one sentence explaining the difference: which geom connects observations in the order they appear in the data (time order), and why that matters for showing how the economy evolved.

## Question 3

Using the `mpg` dataset, plot `displ` vs `hwy` with one smooth line per vehicle class. First try mapping `colour = class` inside `aes()`, then try a version where the points are a single colour but you add `geom_smooth(aes(group = class), se = FALSE)`. Combine points and smooths as multiple geoms in one plot.

Write one sentence explaining what the `group` aesthetic does when you do not want a separate colour (or legend) for each group.
